headline: Fronts Intensify Across Six Sectors as Ownership Shifts Surge
war_summary: Since the 00:10 edition the war has sharpened on a half‑dozen fronts. Weathered Expanse, still the bloodiest sector, recorded three ownership changes in the last two hours while casualties remain extreme at roughly 1,180 colonial and 1,110 warden losses per hour. Stlican Shelf has accelerated to eight flips in the same window, with casualties climbing to about 100 colonial and 98 warden per hour. Stonecradle, which previously surged, shows no new flips in the past two hours though casualties stay high (≈270 colonial, 360 warden per hour). Linn Mercy added two recent flips, casualties rising to 406 colonial and 613 warden per hour. Fishermans Row’s activity eased to three flips in two hours, yet both sides suffer accelerating losses (≈400 colonial, 590 warden per hour). Godcrofts erupted with nine flips in two hours, casualties modest but rising. Callahan’s Passage, quiet for six hours, now logs two flips. Farranac Coast remains static with no recent changes. All other regions report no ownership activity.
